title: Axlatga tashlangan qo'lyozma 400 ming dollarlik bitimga aylandi...
hook: Axlatdan olingan 3 sahifa romanga, roman 400 ming dollarlik bitimga aylandi.

scenes.text: Maktab o'qituvchisi Stiven King yangi romanining ilk 3 sahifasini axlat qutisiga tashladi.
Rafiqasi Tabita sahifalarni olib o'qidi va unga davom ettirishni maslahat berdi.
Roman "Kerri" deb ataldi. Doubleday nashriyoti unga 2500 dollar avans berdi.
Keyin kitobning arzon nashr huquqi 400 ming dollarga sotildi. Uning yarmi Kingga tegdi.
Kitob 1974 yilda chiqdi. King o'qituvchilikni tashlab, butunlay yozuvchilikka o'tdi.

description:
Stiven King "Kerri" romanining ilk sahifalarini axlatga tashlagan, rafiqasi Tabita ularni olib, davom ettirishga undagan. Doubleday 2500 dollar avans bergan, arzon nashr huquqi esa 400 ming dollarga sotilgan, uning yarmi Kingga tegan. Kitob 1974 yilda chiqqan.

Siz qaysi ishingizni tashlab yuborishga yaqin qolgansiz? Izohda yozing.
source: Fact-checked 2026-11-23 (web-search summaries; pages did not open). TRUE: Tabitha King retrieved the discarded pages; Doubleday advance $2,500; paperback rights sold for $400,000 (Signet/New American Library) with half going to King; published 1974. '3 pages' comes from King's own account (about three single-spaced pages). FIXED: hook said the 3 pages 'brought' $400k, which was misleading (the money was a paperback-rights deal for the finished novel, King's share $200k); hook, title and description reworded. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Carrie_(novel) ; https://www.mentalfloss.com/literature/authors/how-stephen-kings-wife-saved-carrie-and-launched-his-career ; https://www.bostonglobe.com/2024/04/04/arts/stephen-kings-first-horror-novel-carrie-50th-anniversary/ ; https://kirkusreviews.com/news-and-features/articles/appreciations-carrie-turns-40 ; https://newengland.com/yankee-magazine/living/profiles/stephen-king/
